# PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Brørup)

PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Brørup) is a psychiatric treatment unit operating under Region Syddanmark, one of Denmark's five healthcare regions[^src1]. The unit appears in the 2024 ADHD database report in connection with Indicator 11, a national measure tracking the share of adult treatment courses in which patients are on ADHD medication within 120 days of starting a structured treatment pathway ("pakkeforløb")[^src1].

According to the reported figures, 48 out of 61 adult patients at PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Brørup) were in ADHD medication treatment, corresponding to 79 percent, with a confidence interval of 66–88 percent[^src1]. This places the unit's result close to the overall pattern described in the surrounding report, which notes wide regional variation on this indicator — from a high of 85 percent in Region Nordjylland to a low of 37 percent in Region Hovedstaden — variation the report attributes primarily to differences in registration practices rather than genuine differences in clinical care[^src1].

The indicator itself is notable because 2024 marked the first year it was calculated for adult patients at all: the ADHD database was expanded that year to include adults, whereas previously it had only covered children and adolescents[^src1]. PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Brørup)'s figure is one data point among many local and regional results presented in this broader national dataset on ADHD treatment quality[^src1].

No relationships, additional claims, or timeline events beyond this single reported statistic are available in the source material.
